subject: general
question: As notified by Government of India in July 2022, Mission Vatsalya, in partnership with states and districts, will execute a 24×7 helpline service for children, as defined under Juvenile Justice Act, ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2015**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mission Vatsalya is an initiative by the Government of India to ensure the welfare and protection of children.
 
• The Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015, provides a framework for the care, protection, and rehabilitation of children in need.
 
• The 24×7 helpline service under Mission Vatsalya aims to provide immediate assistance and support to children in distress.
 
• This initiative will be executed in partnership with states and districts to ensure effective implementation and reach.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015**

 
 
• This Act was enacted to consolidate and amend the law relating to children alleged and found to be in conflict with the law and children in need of care and protection.
 
• It aims to cater to their basic needs through proper care, protection, development, treatment, and social re-integration.
 
• The Act provides for the establishment of Child Welfare Committees and Juvenile Justice Boards in each district.
 
• It also emphasizes the rehabilitation and social re-integration of children through various child care institutions.
 
 
 
• **Mission Vatsalya**
 
 
• Mission Vatsalya is an umbrella scheme for child protection services in India.
 
• It focuses on the welfare of children in difficult circumstances, ensuring their rights and protection.
 
• The mission includes a range of services such as foster care, adoption, and sponsorship to support the holistic development of children.
 
• It also aims to strengthen the child protection mechanism at the district and state levels.
 
 
 
• **Childline 1098**
 
 
• Childline 1098 is a 24x7, free, emergency phone service for children in need of aid and assistance.
 
• The service is managed by Childline India Foundation and operates across various cities and districts in India.
 
• It aims to reach out to children in distress and provide them with immediate assistance, counseling, and rehabilitation services.
 
• Childline 1098 works in collaboration with government bodies, NGOs, and other stakeholders to ensure the safety and well-being of children.
